description: Read an issue's checklist — the '- [ ]' lines of its description — as items, in order: each with a stable 'id' (pass it to check_checklist_item), 'checked', its words ('text', without reminder or picture), its 'depth' when nested, its 'reminder' ('YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' or null) and its 'picture' — the attachment it shows of how the item should look, with the 'content' address its bytes are read at with this same token, or null — and its 'request' when the item asks somebody for a document (a 📎 in its line): 'state' (waiting, overdue past its 'due' day, sent with a file not yet ticked, done once ticked) and the 'files' sent to it, or null for an item that asks for nothing. Needs only permission to see the issue.
name: get_checklist
title: Get checklist
